### GitFileChange

```ts
type GitFileChange = Readonly<{
  path: string;
  content: Uint8Array | null;
  mode?: "100644" | "100755";
}>;
```

One file to write (`content`) or delete (`content: null`), repository-relative.

### MergeBranchRequest


### GitMergeOutcome

```ts
type GitMergeOutcome =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "merged";
      before: string;
      after: string;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "up-to-date";
      head: string;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "conflict";
      head: string;
      paths: readonly string[];
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "stale";
      head: string | null;
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "source-moved";
      head: string;
    }>;
```

What a merge did. Merges always write a merge commit when there is new work.

### MoveRefRequest

```ts
type MoveRefRequest = Readonly<{
  repository: string;
  ref: string;
  expected: string | null;
  commit: string;
  source: string;
}>;
```

Point a ref at a commit that is the head of `source`.

---

### MoveRefsRequest

```ts
type MoveRefsRequest = Readonly<{
  repository: string;
  source: string;
  commit: string;
  updates: readonly Readonly<{
    ref: string;
    expected: string | null;
  }>[];
}>;
```

Ordered ref moves to one fetched source commit; each move has its own CAS guard.

---

### GitRefMovesOutcome

```ts
type GitRefMovesOutcome =
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "updated";
    }>
  | Readonly<{
      kind: "stale";
      ref: string;
      head: string | null;
    }>;
```

Earlier moves remain accepted if a later ref is stale; this is not an atomic
push.
